notes.title: Bermuda Survivor Dev Update!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477189/6bfd21395e98aff55fdb616333624e651a5a26f2.jpg"]
Hey everyone!
Since the release of our demo, we’ve been hard at work expanding Bermuda Survivor and pushing the survivors-like genre in some new (and seriously weird) directions. Today, we want to share with you what we’ve been cooking during the past few months.



Let’s start with the story, because yeah, we’ve finally expanded it a bit. Think about a full-on Bermuda Triangle conspiracy madness. You play as a wannabe action-hero diver, stranded after a research vessel vanishes into the Bermuda Triangle. Your goal? Find your missing crew… and blast your way through an army of monsters while you're doing so.


Hungry for more?
We’ve added a full intro that introduces our main characters.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcCj_Um6i0Psm_KAGXLmIFAsotNsk6gAzExezF977nGGk_KZvesNBLl1hfIeCusAEXz08TAaGQaevpDn6VLSRFYsFcYJ5gFmEpSoK0J-zaDYHlFMkt--9-Cp_lrXoH7OdYraIn3Jw?key=QfO2MXeMdUIrlGIpEVd8aw"]
There’s a lot more happening on the island now, including:
Traps

Quests from rescued crewmates

Secrets to uncover

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXewVpRdOaHjVjrGSTYIAhrrmU8eacCMaCtNuHGRSOAZYmbWlVlKL_u4_nHLAlMOFw16u0lXa-QRmnLHfQwaboETm1s-nmB4vk8faZIFDeN86zfJmphE_P_1H0AvoK4U7teI9uUXrQ?key=QfO2MXeMdUIrlGIpEVd8aw"]
And the weapons? Oh yeah, there are new tools of destruction at your disposal:
A tank. Yes, A TANK.

Grenade launcher (boom)

Rocket launcher (BOOOOM)

A bow

A very much unworthy, still-in-the-stone sword Excalibur (at the end, our guy’s no chosen one… he’s just strong)

A jellyfish tentacle (because everyone loves a bit of Lovecraft)

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeEj18DYzP6R-2XBhwYGIukW_vwxh-3lPFwb642QYnZoInV9JGD_AuGtTgjQZ1VWp3KAfw_2cz-2IKYIf2D6HLVFf81d3tativk5TotJojbvRuc6wz8ECdXHoTQzZg4zsGu-MIfxQ?key=QfO2MXeMdUIrlGIpEVd8aw"]
We’ve also added two new bosses:
An overgrown, very angry chicken (there are also the baby chicks, but those are cute, rather than deadly)

A mysterious monolith that seems to be the source of chaos on the island

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf14Rl5VP_RlHxFkVNtbTPc7BkaB3oijlvg-DVl9-s6-bcNTKs5XNOoX8lLasPZnhMa8E5XwkJ6NvNBrs1JVFnFb75EqGWbAJ7GoabTdy0MdwPzVKTvAc6X3DYz4P7-zs9NhkgU?key=QfO2MXeMdUIrlGIpEVd8aw"]

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcKgyeBkyByIviMtvnKNMDEEWST1MvTcDIj0QB-IChJpbbpZostfasCi5iWN4aZtzW3HS-rnoaWIsaQM0HYO-RTutUyDW02isVW0Wnq-fx3H9BAhNVD2_w0B4oXg1esF88BYiqGSw?key=QfO2MXeMdUIrlGIpEVd8aw"]

For those who crack the island’s secrets, there’s now an endgame mode where you chase high scores to impress the aliens who abducted you (if there wasn’t enough cluster already).

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcOayrAW_GqlX8iLhTv9jx92do_EJKlzRCBFW9vYxrP7hIrkHlazGSb4wRw9Yzx5gDHurhTzkWpP11H4ZwCfz2Q-mEgYnVz4OMpDXFaU4ZGLrxmyHKMnlFcDdpL4sL9lpr2VnDL?key=QfO2MXeMdUIrlGIpEVd8aw"]
Progression has gone meta and become tied to level design:
Unlock new areas and upgrades over time

Some crewmates have machines hidden in caves for permanent upgrades

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfjTFEgWl0grGBFveeFYLnMn4oGH3uAyuWjSs0Eh3qSPwOOlDJWCmq8qNEHMMHvbLZaxDB6wXGzK1x5aKvCAyrLZ-bsF-P7yIwkLcGmMPQjBWpJenVfsG6DC1X83vw_N9DRiFIe?key=QfO2MXeMdUIrlGIpEVd8aw"]
Lastly, for the technical & misc stuff:
We’re adding localization. The full list of languages will be shared later.

Full Steam Deck & gamepad support is on the way

If all goes to plan, a demo version will soon land on consoles!

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfsCP-WFkmLUpC1grqPk663UEVRx6z4Lmx_jx2lAtEiMbgc_M3jpmVDHsa3qURS0-Eo4a7UpLyoPBebPt6iojyy7e1cjJBKWpurDLhPgO5f7tP5qG-v0KijP9i-zHgqjjROcaYDmA?key=QfO2MXeMdUIrlGIpEVd8aw"]

We’re still working on various other quality-of-life improvements and polishing the level art. The big picture goal? To make Bermuda Survivor feel wild, fresh, and super satisfying to play.



Thanks for all the love and feedback so far! The game’s release is closer than you think… Please stay tuned for further updates, as not too long from today we’ll be announcing the date!

Stay safe, Survivors, and most importantly: don’t get Triangled!


Cheers,
Awaken Realms team

notes.title: Bermuda Survivor Demo is now live!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477189/acf346689b52bd30a96711132115a5fba2cbffd6.jpg

Hey, Survivors!

Remember when we announced that the Demo version of Bermuda Survivor would go live on the 24th of February? Well… change of plans:

BERMUDA SURVIVOR DEMO IS NOW LIVE!

That’s right. We managed to get it shipped earlier than expected! After all, the faster you solve the Bermuda riddle, the better for the entire planet…

Watch the trailer and take a peek at what lurks on the island:

[previewyoutube=ddflSWdE0zQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Get ready to experience a unique blend of bullet heaven and world exploration. Your goal is to survive the hordes of enemies and discover the secrets of the Bermuda Triangle. Each run will provide new unlockables, story bits, NPC-related quests, and optimal paths to achieve victory!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477189/48b35bdfbaeb1e1580955a7ee400268b93dabc79.jpg
What makes Bermuda Survivor stand out is meaningful exploration. Unlike most similar games, the map layout is fixed, allowing you to master every corner and find the most efficient routes to succeed. Locked doors, shortcuts, and hidden paths await!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477189/11b120d2658085580f3fd7a5f1c48605341bd5f5.jpg
Remember that this demo version is only a tiny slice of what the game will become in the future! So, what to expect?

 1 island to explore
 12 doors & hidden paths to unlock
 7 ranged weapons
 4 melee weapons
 50 various abilities
 15 buff shrines
 4 regular enemy types
 1 powerful boss enemy
 1 faction to cooperate with
 6 NPCs
 3 quests
 3 "hub" locations (the main hub, the shop, and the research facility)
 3 destructible obstacles

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477189/8c0a4238228311ff324a5d8076a82693b3bd412d.jpg

Now, go ahead and try your luck as a Bermuda Survivor! Can you vanquish the horde and unravel the island’s secrets?

Join our Discord server to chat about the game and provide feedback: https://discord.com/invite/X6WNQUUJnx

Stay safe, stay alive!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2800280/Bermuda_Survivor/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477189/4ded31e35b837b1a0ad7dfaad628c92c6471bf72.jpg
